verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documented way to pick a storage region or data-residency location for inboxes, messages or attachments. The only related signal is a community comment that enterprise plans include a 'Bring Your Own Cloud' option. That describes a deployment model, not a documented region or residency control, and it is not backed by first-party docs. SOC 2 and pod isolation cover different privacy controls and do not show where data is stored.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
